panels.title: Alert mới nhất — bấm tên rule để mở trên console

targets.query: event.category:authentication AND event.outcome:success AND user.name:(root OR Administrator OR admin)

targets.query: event.category:authentication OR (event.category:web AND http.request.method:POST AND url.path:*login*)
